top_choice_rationale: Pd-catalysed C-N coupling to Buchwald and Hartwig is the one proposal that meets all my tests at once: a structurally and mechanistically established catalyst cycle (ligand control of reductive elimination from Pd-amido complexes against beta-hydride elimination), more than 25 years of independent confirmation and daily use across discovery, process and materials chemistry, and a clean two-name allocation. Adding Liu (P003) is acceptable but unrelated to B002; degradation (P001, P005, P002) has no approved degrader and, in P002, one citation spans both the PROTAC and cereblon strands, so I rank Ciulli's structure-guided contribution (P005) above Handa (P002). Any award is preferred to none.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no direct connection to B002, B029 or B018 candidates (Stockholm colleague of Brzezinski is not a candidate link)
